'''Jorlen Corbesan''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] from the [[Age of Legends]].

== History ==
He crafted many of the most amazing ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in his research facility of [[Sharom]]. He died by the backlash of Power from the [[Bore]].
